goal: Make engineering work reproducible and continuable without requiring a particular person to remain available.
scope: An optional, local handoff format for contributors.
No changes to protocol contracts, GitHub permissions, merge policy, or node operation.

evidence.meaning: The protocol's stated aim is to avoid an indispensable controller, while acknowledging contributors and cornerstones.
Existing handoff concepts are documented for agents; this proposal targets portable contributor handoffs.

decisions.reason: Continuity must not require a new central approver or prevent someone from contributing.

decisions.choice: Do not require a maintainer identity or an assigned successor.
decisions.reason: A handoff can be usable even when no one has volunteered to continue it.

checks.expected: All local continuity validator tests pass without installing dependencies.

unknowns: Whether other contributors find the fields useful; revise or discard the proposal based on review.
nextSteps: Invite independent review of the example and checker; do not make it a merge gate without separate consensus.
